summary: Practise task selection, decision boundaries and follow-up with RACI, SMART briefs and coaching exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Delegation training helps supervisors, team leads and project coordinators assign work with clear ownership, authority and follow-up. You practise selecting suitable tasks, setting SMART outcomes and RACI ownership, coaching handoffs with GROW, and planning check-ins, feedback and escalation so decisions can move closer to the work while accountability remains clear.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits professionals who assign work, coordinate shared tasks or support colleagues taking on greater responsibility. It is designed for people who need to clarify ownership and authority in everyday team delivery.
prerequisites: Basic workplace experience involving task allocation, work coordination or team collaboration is useful. No coding or programming is required.
